name: hud_ui_timer_panel_set_running
description: HudUiTimerPanel::SetRunning stores the inverse stopped flag on the global timer panel.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; coverage is functional and uses the global timer-panel fixture.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x40eca0 validates testing the incoming running value, loading g_HudUiMgrTimerPanel, zero-extending the equality result, and storing the integer stopped flag at offset 0x2a8.
The native timer-panel accessor smoke verifies SetRunning(0) stores stopped=1 and SetRunning(1) stores stopped=0 on the global timer panel.
